description_en: Calls the CheckVpnBgpEnabled operation to query whether the region to which an IPsec-VPN connection belongs supports the BGP feature
description_zh: 调用CheckVpnBgpEnabled接口查询IPsec连接所属的地域是否支持BGP功能
name: CheckVpnBgpEnabled

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

BgpEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the current region supports the BGP feature.

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
BgpEnabled.description_zh:
当前地域是否支持BGP功能。

true：支持。
false：不支持
